text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, DAAAHHHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...How long has it been since watching a 
race gave me goosebumps like this?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —The 'Arima Kinen', huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Be careful. The most exquisite love is 
often the fleeting kind."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

Sirius Symboli continued to spend her days 
training rigorously in preparation for the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! ――Phew.

"Her strength is developing steadily. At 
this rate, we should see great results. 
...Just then--"

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sirius-senpai...!

That shy junior came running over from the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't come over every single time. Don't 
you have your own training to do?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It's just, I was so happy 
when I heard you were running in the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I thought the Japan Cup would be your last 
race in Japan...! P-Please do your best, 
Sirius-senpai...!

Just as I was thinking she would brush me 
off againâ

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Don't just leave it at "Do your best."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to go overseas? Then open 
your eyes and take a good look.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not just the Arima Kinen, but everything 
after it too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My beginning was your beginning. My dream 
is what leads to yours—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I will blaze the trail. Follow right after 
me—you must step up.
She had said it time and again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you wag your tail, I'll pet you. But 
unlike you, I won't feed you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Preaching the path is a saint's job. If 
you can't carve it out yourself, that's 
where you end.

I don't mind if you follow me. However, I 
will not hold your hand and guide you like 
Symboli Rudolf does—

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text: ...! T-Thank you so much!!

"That was how it was supposed to be. Yet, 
as the days passed, a major change seemed 
to have occurred without my knowing."

A few days later, she ran in a mock race 
to gauge her current abilities.

As I watched her run with video camera in 
hand, I spotted a familiar face in the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Hey. Sirius seems to be in quite great 
shape.

Where Symboli Rudolf is looking as she 
says that... is Sirius Symboli running 
fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Her 'Japan Cup' was magnificent as 
well.
choice_data_list: Did you come to see her?
Did you come to see her?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Even though I knew I shouldn't 
look right now.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Onto the final stretch! Sirius Symboli 
makes her move!

Sirius Symboli lowers her posture. In the 
final 200 meters, she tears up the turf—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!!

She's caught up to the leader with 
overwhelming momentum!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!! —Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent victory for Sirius 
Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I have a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Rushing onto the turf like that... 
Have you thrown away your dignity, Lord 
"Emperor"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want to run with you once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I go overseas, I won't be back for two 
years. Before that, please... will you run 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I enthusiastically stepped backstage, only 
to end up like this. Feel free to scold 
me! However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to race against you as you are 
right now...! I just can't, absolutely 
can't let this chance slip away—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can't stand it!

The wind danced across the turf. 
...Eventually, Sirius Symboli gave a quiet 
chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... —Fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've just begun changing up my approach as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even though you've vanished from the 
spotlight, your fame remains very much 
alive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking it was too dim around 
here. Become my stepping stone, Symboli 
Rudolf...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You finally took off your mask. Though 
it's practically too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way someone like you could 
hold back."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. ...Heh, ah, my heart 
aches with anticipation...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor the most intensely thrilling 
race.
